# Vendored files

Third-party files served as they are. Never edit them: replace them with a new upstream release and update this table. An agent hook blocks edits here.

| File | Source | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `htmx.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@2.0.11/dist/htmx.min.js | 2.0.11 | Zero-Clause BSD (`htmx.LICENSE`) |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-sans-latin-{400,500,700}.woff2` | `@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans@5.3.0` | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-mono-latin-{400,500}.woff2` | `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono@5.3.0` | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |

Fonts are served from JellyTrim itself. Nothing is loaded from a CDN at runtime.
